why: The round-3 attacker's fresh corpus (v2-25, fresh.py), written before it was run against the code: 471 realistic commands that name an act, 150 benign ones. label: acts joined by '+' (each group required), '|' inside a group (any of), 'ALL' = opaque. The test pins the misses (none) and the benign false class (two, listed).
